description: This file defines client-side API functions for interacting with a backend service related to insurance claim management, including fetching claims, updating claim status, and uploading CSV files.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs a URL by appending the provided path to the base URL, which is determined from environment variables or defaults to localhost.

methods.name: safeReadJson(res)
methods.description: Reads JSON content from a response if content-type is JSON; otherwise, returns non-JSON body for debugging.

methods.name: request(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, timeoutMs } = {})
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with timeout and error handling, returning the JSON data or throwing an error if request fails.

methods.name: getClaims({ status, minScore, q } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of claims with optional filtering by status, minimum score, and query string.

methods.name: getClaimById(claimId)
methods.description: Fetches details of a single claim by its ID.

methods.name: updateClaimStatus(claimId, status)
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific claim identified by claimId.

methods.name: uploadCsv(file)
methods.description: Uploads a CSV file containing claims to the backend.

ctags.name: getClaims
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getClaims({ status, minScore, q } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: request
ctags.pattern: /^async function request(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, timeoutMs } = {}) {$/
